description: No key. Stop the renewal of an advertisement that was booked with renew: true. Needs the booking id and the stop key from its stop link (book_sponsor_place returned both; the link stands on every Stripe invoice). Nothing more is charged; the advertisement runs to the end of the paid period (terms 7e). Safe to call twice.

stop_key.description: The key from the stop link (the part after k=).

name: stop_ad_renewal
